scope: Actual rendered PlayCanvas/GLB footage, not illustrations. Original captured frames reused for corrected encoding; no synthetic/interpolated motion. Gallery clip playback, staged authoritative ability fixtures, staged unit snapshots and two staged coastal views are labelled. Four city shots are ordinary native practice.

ability.name: Steady Arrow
ability.description: Fire a powerful aimed projectile. Cover blocks the shot.

ability.name: Measured Step
ability.description: Dash forward up to 10 metres. Walls stop the movement.

ability.name: Dawn Volley
ability.description: Brace in place for 1 second, then release three arrows along the locked firing angle. Each arrow can hit separately; cover blocks them.

ability.name: Tenfold Guard
ability.description: Grant a temporary shield to yourself and nearby allies.

ability.name: Commanding Circle
ability.description: Damage enemies in the aimed circle and pull them toward its centre. Solid cover limits displacement.

ability.name: Crownfire
ability.description: Blast enemies around you in a broad circle.

ability.name: Converging Volley
ability.description: Strike enemies in a forward fan within 18 metres.

ability.name: New Angle
ability.description: Dash forward up to 12 metres to change your firing position.

ability.name: One Clear Line
ability.description: Fire a fast, heavy projectile along your aim.

ability.name: Mace Shock
ability.description: Strike enemies in the short area in front of you.

ability.name: Hold the Ground
ability.description: Shield yourself and close allies for a brief defensive stand.

ability.name: Iron Crescent
ability.description: Sweep a heavy wave through enemies in a broad forward cone.

ability.name: Windward Leap
ability.description: Leap forward up to 14 metres. Solid obstacles stop your advance.

ability.name: Bring Them Home
ability.description: Restore health to yourself and allies close to you.

ability.name: Mountain Pulse
ability.description: Brace for 0.7 seconds, then leap to the aimed ground point. On landing, damage nearby enemies and heal nearby allies. Cover limits travel.

ability.name: Sunshaft
ability.description: Fire a fast aimed projectile through a clear firing lane.

ability.name: Borrowed Dawn
ability.description: Give yourself and nearby allies a short-lived shield.

ability.name: Solar Reprisal
ability.description: Strike enemies immediately around you with a bright area blast.

ability.name: Heavy Sweep
ability.description: Strike enemies in a close forward cone.

ability.name: Closing Stride
ability.description: Leap forward up to 12 metres. Walls stop the advance.

ability.name: Thunder at Your Feet
ability.description: Damage enemies in a wide circle around you.

ability.name: Cloud Snare
ability.description: Place an aimed zone that damages and slows enemies who remain inside.

ability.name: Storm Step
ability.description: Dash forward up to 13 metres, stopping at solid cover.

ability.name: Gathered Squall
ability.description: Strike enemies in a long forward fan.

ability.name: Grove Renewal
ability.description: Restore health to yourself and allies within the nearby circle.

ability.name: Rooted Path
ability.description: Place an aimed zone that damages and slows enemies crossing it.

ability.name: Shelter of Mithila
ability.description: Prepare in place for 0.8 seconds, then raise a fixed sanctuary for 6 seconds. Nearby allies gain a shield; allies who remain inside steadily recover health.

ability.name: Circle of Resolve
ability.description: Give yourself and close allies a temporary shield.

ability.name: Stand Accountable
ability.description: Damage enemies in the aimed circle and pull them toward its centre; solid cover limits movement.

ability.name: Unbroken Assembly
ability.description: Restore a large amount of health to yourself and allies in a broad nearby circle.

ability.name: Signal Lance
ability.description: Fire an aimed energy projectile toward the opposing line.

ability.name: Rally Close
ability.description: Restore health to yourself and allies close to your position.

ability.name: Twin Standards
ability.description: Call two temporary allied sentinels beside you for 9 seconds.

ability.name: Forest Boundary
ability.description: Place a nearby aimed zone that damages and slows enemies inside it.

ability.name: Canopy Guard
ability.description: Shield yourself and allies standing close to you.

ability.name: Grove Watch
ability.description: Call two temporary allied sentinels beside you for 9 seconds.

ability.name: Crossing Step
ability.description: Dash forward up to 12 metres to cross or leave a firing lane. Solid obstacles stop movement.

ability.name: Spear Arc
ability.description: Strike enemies in a close forward cone with a sweeping energy blade.

ability.name: Defender’s Vow
ability.description: Grant a strong temporary shield to yourself and nearby allies. Gather close before committing to the fight.

ability.name: River Draw
ability.description: Damage enemies in the aimed circle and draw them toward its centre. Solid cover limits displacement.

ability.name: Cooling Current
ability.description: Restore health to yourself and allies standing nearby.

ability.name: Naga Basin
ability.description: Place a broad aimed zone that damages and slows enemies remaining inside for up to 6 seconds.

captureRecovery.scope: Two capture epochs with byte-identical runtime/shared/asset sources. Only the capture tool changed. Original failed evidence remains untouched. Reused frames are copied and SHA-256 hashed; only the two coastal views are recaptured.

encodingRecovery.reason: Previous VFR H264 B-frame ordering underdeclared some MP4 durations and made concatenated chapter timestamps run backwards. Reencode original JPEGs with B-frames disabled; require decoded PTS, packet PTS/DTS and end-duration validity for every clip/chapter/reel. No browser recapture or runtime change.

videoTiming.scope: Captured SwiftShader/CDP cadence is not a hardware/game performance benchmark; image timebase quantization and final hold are recorded per shot in the full local manifest.

reel.scope: Selected real clips; full roster/ability/unit coverage remains in the chapter files.

limitations: Silent videos; no microphone or synthesized sound is recorded.
Staged demonstrations do not establish human-match outcomes, earned rewards or public multiplayer readiness.
Beta art at actual gameplay/gallery framing; no claim of commercial polish or exact resemblance to concept illustrations.
Raw JPEGs, duplicate per-shot MP4s and temporary files are omitted from the compact ZIP and remain in the full local artifact directory.
Original failed camera campaign and superseded B-frame encoding are preserved, not relabelled as successful single-pass evidence.
